people.name: Aristarchus
people.line: Macedonian companion of Paul, fellow prisoner

people.name: Gaius
people.line: Macedonian; Paul's traveling companion; caught in Ephesian riot.

people.name: Macedonia
people.line: A region in northern Greece; Paul preached there

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.
translations.bsb: Soon the whole city was in disarray. They rushed together into the theatre, dragging with them Gaius and Aristarchus, Paul’s traveling companions from Macedonia.
translations.kjv: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
translations.asv: And the city was filled with the confusion: and they rushed with one accord into the theatre, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel.
